_doc: Release gate symbol list (release-gates.cjs --probe-free). Any test-only log/probe wrapped in /*QF_PROBE_BEGIN*/…/*QF_PROBE_END*/ is stripped generically by strip-probes.cjs; ADD its unique log tag / global here so the release build is proven free of it. literal = plain substring; regex = JS regex source. Never list tags that predate the probes and ship on purpose (e.g. the BalloonTransit [QF_B1_GAP] totalMs summary, bdd3c6d7).
